0715Mechanics and metal trades

Text-to-CAD and drawing-to-CAD training environment

jessicayjung75/text-to-cad-training-env

Produce one exact solid as a STEP file (or watertight STL) in CadQuery from a text or drawing specification.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • RL on mechanical CAD
  • training rather than frontier evaluation

Reward

How it is scored
Programmatic check
Signal
Pass or fail

A hidden parametric reference and a geometric grader decide pass or fail.

How to run it

1. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download jessicayjung75/text-to-cad-training-env --repo-type dataset --local-dir text-to-cad-training-env

This repository is gated: request access on the Hub and log in with hf auth login first.

2. Check it with Harborcommon pattern, not from this card

# the oracle agent runs the reference solution, so no model is called
harbor run --repo https://huggingface.co/datasets/jessicayjung75/text-to-cad-training-env --agent oracle

If every task passes, the environment works on your machine. Then swap in your own agent and model. Some repositories keep the tasks in a subfolder; the card says where.
